title: Law to require guidance on service animal access rights
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, working with the Commission on Human Rights and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, to create guidance and a public education campaign about service animal access at businesses and other public places. It would require pamphlets, model signage and online materials explaining what counts as a service animal, what businesses must allow, and how to file a complaint if denied access. The materials must be reviewed and updated at least every three years, starting within one year of the law taking effect.
